title: Jesus... I Skipped My Prayer Tonight. Nothing Is Moving. 🕯️
topic: he quietly skipped his nightly prayer for the first time in months because the long silence has drained his faith that watching changes anything

bible.text: Take ye heed, watch and pray: for ye know not when the time is.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... I skipped my prayer tonight. First time in months. 🕯️

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Not because I stopped believing. Nothing is moving, and I ran out of words.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You didn't run out of words. You lost faith that watching changes anything.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: But You said ask. You never said the silence would last this long.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: I said watch and pray because you don't know the timing. Not knowing isn't a reason to leave your post tonight.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: One tired prayer puts you back on watch. I'm waiting with you.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to the friend who quietly stopped praying. 🕯️
